sloka: विद्युद्भिः इव विक्षिप्तैः आकाशम् अभवत् तदा ।पाण्डुरैः सलिल उत्पीडैः कीर्यमाणैः सहस्रधा ॥१-४३-२२॥
transliteration: vidyudbhiḥ iva vikṣiptaiḥ ākāśam abhavat tadā ।pāṇḍuraiḥ salila utpīḍaiḥ kīryamāṇaiḥ sahasradhā ॥1-43-22॥

translations.english: White foams of water were scattered in a thousand ways. It appeared as if the sky was spread over with autumnal clouds flocks of swans.
